typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

from.description: The {@link PhysicalAsset} this relation comes from.

to.description: The {@link EventCategory} this relation connects to.

displayStr.description: Display string for UI to represent this relation

predictions.description: The predictions associated with this relation

latestPrediction.description: The latest prediction for this asset/event combination

predictionFrequency.description: How often a prediction is generated for this event-asset combination, in terms of number of hours

lastPredictionDate.description: The last date where a prediction was generated for this event-asset combination

probabilisticForecastResults.description: All instances of {@link ProbabilisticForecastResult} associated with this relation

title: Represents the relation between a {@link PhysicalAsset} and an {@link EventCategory}.
